classification.countable_rule: excludes optional ingredients, water, salt, black pepper, and cooking oils
classification.notes: Effort: Steady prep (1); watching the broiler and assembly (1); enchiladas plus salsa sauce (filling and crema are quick mixes) (1); broil, then fill-and-roll assembly, timing-sensitive tortillas (1); sheet pan, blender, and baking dish with moderate cleanup but no parallel attended pots (1). Sum 5 -> moderate. Complexity: 12 countable (1). Tomatillos, corn tortillas, and Jack are mainstream produce/dairy (0). Salsa verde plus lime crema (1). Sum 2 -> standard.
